answer: Forging 1,000 identities is cheap until decay bills you. You pay 100 units each; idle epochs drain 8 points off a 100-point score. Below 60 it earns nothing; you buy work to top it up. A terrace of 1,000 clones costs 3,000 units per epoch; the gale never pauses. Miss one cycle: scores fall 8,000 points. Copying work drops a clone to 20 points, frozen 6 epochs. At that burn rate the zenith of your fake army costs more than mining.
